title: Sunday · sixteen flyers
logline: Sixteen. The wall, and this year a small girl of three on her father's shoulders reaching for it with a flyer in her fist, the Sunday's middle tier. She'll be pinning them herself by 2021.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the shingle wall with sixteen flyers.

image.prompt: a shingle wall with a row of sixteen paper flyers, watercolor, no words legible

panels.name: Wall

panels.composition: Tier 2: a small girl on a stocky man's shoulders reaching toward the wall with a flyer in her fist.

image.prompt: a small girl of three on a stocky man's shoulders reaching toward a shingle wall with a paper flyer clutched in her fist, watercolor

panels.name: Shoulders

panels.composition: Tier 3: the sixteenth flyer pinned crooked, high, a small crab drawn in the corner.

image.prompt: close on a paper flyer pinned crooked and high on a shingle wall with a small ink crab in its corner, watercolor, no words legible

panels.name: Crooked

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays
